content.title: Music & Concerts | Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo
content.text: Click each location below to learn more! THE STAR STAGE Each night, once the Rodeo dust settles, a superstar takes the stage to entertain the crowds. The star entertainers begin performing after the last rodeo event is completed each evening and the stage is set. Actual start times for the concert can vary day to day due to the different number of rodeo competitors and other production elements. Tickets are required for entry. Weekday rodeos start at 6:45 p.m. The entertainer takes the stage at approximately 9:15 p.m. NRG Stadium gates open at 6 p.m. Weekend rodeos start at 2:45 p.m. The entertainer takes the stage at approximately 5:15 p.m. NRG Stadium gates open at 2 p.m THE GARDEN STAGE The Garden Stage presents some of the best names in Texas country music. The Garden Stage is located in the center of the contest grounds during World’s Champion Bar-B-Que Contest, presented by Cotton Holdings. This stage is open to the public. THE HIDEOUT Dance the night away at the Rodeo’s very own honky tonk, The Hideout! Equipped with a spacious dance floor, bars and some of the best up-and-coming musicians, The Hideout is open for those 21 years of age and older, for just the cost of admission to NRG Park. The Hideout is located in a white tent on the west side of NRG Arena. This venue is open to the public. Hours: 6 p.m. to midnightLive music begins at 10:00 p.m. on weeknights (Monday-Friday) and 8 p.m. on weekends (Saturday-Sunday). Champion Wine Garden The Champion Wine Garden is an oasis that offers a cheerful atmosphere, top-notch entertainment from rising Texas stars and a chance to savor more than 75 award-winning wines. This venue is open to the public. Wine Garden Entertainment Times: Mondays – Thursdays 4 p.m. – 11 p.m.Fridays 2 p.m. – MidnightSaturdays 11 a.m. – Midnight Sundays 10 a.m. – 10 p.m. THE JUNCTION STAGE Get ready to rock at the Junction Stage! The stage features family entertainment and live music performances from rising stars. This stage is open to the public. The Watering Hole Enjoy live performances while you shop and dine in Hall E, located at NRG Center. The Watering Hole stage is open to the public. CORRAL CLUBS Looking for a place to meet up with your Rodeo buddies? Corral Club offers locations throughout the Rodeo grounds where you can enjoy a drink throughout the Show or keep the party going. Become a Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Annual or Lifetime member today and enjoy several private venue areas throughout the Rodeo grounds. Memberships are available for purchase at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Membership Office. Call 832.667.1073 or email membership@rodeohouston.com if you need additional information or assistance with your membership. Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Corral Clubs are Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission-licensed establishments and are cashless. NRG Arena STOCKMAN’S CLUB Location: Southeast end of NRG Arena, 2nd level Hours: Daily: noon to midnight Live Music: Thursday and Friday performances begin at 10:15 p.m. Saturday performances begin at 8:15 p.m. Club Details: Open to all HLSR volunteers with a gold badge and their guests, or members current HLSR Annual Member Card that possess an HLSR Life Member Card, Credentials, Horse Show Exhibitor Credentials, or current HLSR Annual Member Card Supervised minors (Under 21) allowed until 8 p.m. daily. After 8 p.m. club is 21+ Seating, recorded music and/or band and numerous televisions featuring Show activities Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase, all drinks will be priced at $6 for beer, wine and liquor Complimentary soft drinks and water will be available NRG Center COMMITTEEMEN’S CLUB Location: Rooms 604-605 in NRG Center, West end, 2nd levelHours: Daily: noon to midnight Club Details: Open to Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo gold badge holders and their accompanied guest Supervised minors (Under 21) allowed until 8 p.m. daily. After 8 p.m. club is 21+ Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase, all drinks will be priced at $6 for beer, wine and liquor Complimentary soft drinks and water will be available Seating, recorded music and numerous televisions featuring Show activities MAIN CLUB Location: East end of the 300 series rooms in NRG Center, 2nd levelHours: Monday-Friday: 5 p.m. to midnight Saturday-Sunday: noon to midnight Live Music: Thursday and Friday performances begin at 10:15 p.m. Saturday performances begin at 8:15 p.m. Club Details: Open to Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Annual/Lifetime Members, gold badge holders, show credentials and accompanied guest No minors allowed at any time Seating, live and recorded music Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase, all drinks will be priced at $6 for beer, wine and liquor Complimentary soft drinks and water will be available NRG Park THE HIDEOUT Location: Tent on the west side of NRG Arena Club Details: Open to everyone ages 21 and up Dance floor, live and recorded music No minors allowed at any time Click here for live entertainment information Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase (show Annual/Lifetime Membership card or gold badge for member prices), $7 for all standard bar selections, premium pricing will be charged for specialty drinks and wine selections Complimentary water will be available NRG Stadium To gain admission to NRG Stadium, a valid ticket for the rodeo performance, gold badge or proper Rodeo credentials must be presented. Annual/Lifetime Membership cards alone will not grant access to NRG Stadium, even if the sole intent is to enter a Corral Club venue. THE CANTINA Location: South end of public concourse, level 1Hours: Open daily: one hour prior to Rodeo performance until the concert ends Club Details: Open to Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Annual/Lifetime Members, gold badge holders, season ticket holders, show credentials and accompanied guest No minors allowed at any time Video monitors with live Rodeo action and concert performances Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase, all drinks will be priced at $6 for beer, wine and liquor Complimentary soft drinks and water will be available CHUTE CLUB Location: North end of public concourse, level 1Hours: Open daily: one hour prior to Rodeo performance until the concert ends Club Details: Open to Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Annual/Lifetime Members, gold badge holders, show credentials and accompanied guest No minors allowed at any time Video monitors with live Rodeo action and concert performances Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase, all drinks will be priced at $6 for beer, wine and liquor Complimentary soft drinks and water will be available CLUB LEVEL EAST AND WEST Location: East and West side, level 3Hours: Open daily: one hour prior to Rodeo performance until the concert ends Club Details: Open to Rodeo Club Level ticket holders only Alcoholic drinks will be available for purchase (show Annual/Lifetime Membership card or gold badge for member prices), drink prices for the general ticketed public will be $7 for all standard bar selections, and premium pricing will be charged for specialty drinks and wine selections
